response.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count::numeric / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts

assumptions.assumption: An order with multiple matching risk/margin records counts once.
A matched user with a NULL account scope appears as a separate scope group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count every matching risk/margin record, so an order with multiple records contributes multiple times.
alternatives.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, match_count, match_count::numeric / SUM(match_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, match_count::numeric / AVG(match_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts

alternatives.interpretation: Count orders once per scope, but include only users with a specified account scope.
alternatives.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count::numeric / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts
